rulings: Stage-5 proposal accepted unchanged: only «چھو کر» becomes «کھول کر»; every other byte equals the pack current (N620 first sentence, «کسی مقام کو», «اسے دیکھیں», «اپنے سفر کے لیے محفوظ کریں۔»). «کھول کر … اسے دیکھیں» renders en_after “Open one to see it” and the Arabic «اضغط على معلمٍ لتراه» (owner decision 2, 2026-10-21): a tap and a mouse click both open the place, so the verb is device-neutral, as the blind reader confirms in (b). «کھولنا» is the line's established device-neutral UI verb (asfar faq[1].a, N89-interface-labels-quoted-in-a-sentence: «… کا لنک کھولیں۔», where readers rejected «دبائیں» for a phone). Refused alternatives: «چن کر» / «منتخب کر کے» repeat the choose-verb of the title «جو دل کو بھائے، وہ چنیں» (N613), which decision 2 forbids; «کلک کر کے» / «ٹیپ کر کے» are loans with a native verb available and each narrows to one device (P16, N332); «دبا کر» refused by N332 (C) and the asfar readers. Deductions: accuracy -2 and nativeness -3 for the weak but real reading of «مقام کو کھولنا» as a place opened to visitors and the slight oddness of opening a place, both noted by the blind reader; judged acceptable because the sentence is an imperative to the reader on a map chapter whose items are clickable, and no verb-only fix removes it without the title verb or a loan. Traveller fit -1 for the same. This answers owner question map-touch-verb left open in N620; recorded as N720.
blind_disposition: Item 1 («کسی مقام کو چن کر اس کی تفصیل دیکھیں»): rejected. «چن کر» repeats the title's choose-verb (N613; owner decision 2), and «تفصیل» adds a noun the source lacks (en “to see it”, ar «لتراه»: the object is the place itself, so «اسے دیکھیں» is faithful). Directed question (a) ambiguity of «مقام کو کھولنا»: acknowledged and charged (accuracy/nativeness), not repaired, for the reasons in rulings; its own remedies «چن کر» and «پر کلک یا ٹیپ کر کے» are refused under N613/decision 2 and P16/N332. Directed question (b): confirms «کھولنا» is device-neutral; applied as the basis of the decision. Item 2 (lead «کھول کر» vs empty-state hint «کوئی مقام چنیں»): out of scope; the hint is a separate published string not in this batch, logged for the owner (whether the hint keeps «چنیں», which matches the title, or follows the lead). Item 3 («وقت کے تراشے ہوئے غار» → «وقت کے ہاتھوں تراشے ہوئے غار»): out of scope, another published string, logged for the owner, no deduction. Item 4 (stray «جبل القارہ کا صفحہ ←»): artifact of the dist cut, it is the tail of the previous chapter; no action. Item 5 («جھیل الاصفر»): out of scope, and fixed by N83 (title starts with «جھیل» then the name with its article); logged as reader taste, no change.

new_rulings.title: map.lead: the action verb after owner decision 2 (2026-10-21), “Open one to see it” / «اضغط على معلمٍ لتراه».
new_rulings.ruling: The conjunctive participle is «کھول کر»: «کسی مقام کو کھول کر اسے دیکھیں». Device-neutral for tap and mouse click (asfar «لنک کھولیں» precedent; blind reader 7st-touch (b)). Not «چن کر» / «منتخب کر کے» (title verb, N613; decision 2), not «کلک» / «ٹیپ» (P16, N332), not «دبا کر» (N332 C), not «چھو کر» (touch-only; closes owner question map-touch-verb of N620). No noun such as «تفصیل» is added.
new_rulings.guard: Stage checker on HOME_COPY.ur.map.lead only: «چھو کر» does not occur, and «کسی مقام کو کھول کر اسے دیکھیں» occurs.
